name: qaqa_search
description: Use this for current events, recent versions, facts, prices, exchange rates, weather, or anything you are unsure about. It searches multiple engines, extracts clean page content, and returns results in the same language as the query. Cite results as [1], [2] and verify every number/date strictly against the returned content. Prefer results with a published_at or updated_at date for freshness questions (both null = no date; updated_at = last modification, not publication). STRICT HALLUCINATION RULE: If results are empty, meta.confidence is 'low' or 'none', or meta.fallback is true, explicitly tell the user you could not find/verify the answer — NEVER guess or fill gaps from your own memory. Weather/time/currency queries return exact official structured data (Open-Meteo / Asia-Baku / CBAR).

query.description: Axtarış sualı. Hansı dildə yazsan, cavab da həmin dildə qaytarılır (AZ/TR/EN).

max_chars.description: Ümumi mətn limiti. Default 4000, min 500, max 8000.

format.description: json = tək JSON obyekt (default), jsonl = hər sətir JSON (stream), simple = yalnız title/url/snippet

freshness.description: Təzilik filtri - yalnız bu müddət daxilində nəşr olunmuş nəticələr (məs. 'week').
